validation._note: Deliberately unvalidated, and it must stay that way. This is the fixture the validation-gate tests use. They used to point at a shipped pack, which meant that measuring a real pack over a corpus - the exact thing the gate exists to encourage - broke three tests of the gate itself. A fixture cannot be allowed to graduate.
